source: Office of the Economic Adviser (WPI); seasonality derived

methodology.marketing_year: Each commodity uses its own marketing year; months ordered to that year
methodology.share: each month's WPI index / that marketing year's sum of 12 monthly index values (Year Sum)
methodology.seasonality: simple average of the per-year shares across the 3 years shown
methodology.interpretation: WPI is a price index, so shares sit near 1/12 (~0.083); months above are relatively high-price within the year, below are relatively low
methodology.years: last 3 marketing years available per base; latest windows may be partial where data ends (Old base Apr 2026, New base Jun 2026), shares normalized over available months
